reaction: The final packing step was predictable and useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the net and using it at the shore was the most worthwhile sequence: it connected gathering food to preserving it for the crossing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Packing the pickles was straightforward but offered little decision-making; it was the only combination offered.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; vinegar and the subsequent pickles matched my expectations.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though the compatible-options menu meant I did not have to discover the recipes myself.

continue.text: I might continue for the unfolding settlement story, though this chapter's predictable, mostly linear combinations were not a strong hook on their own.
